themes.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: actual production hockey-pool website artwork, not a mockup. Input image is the layout reference and edit target. Create a new themed version in exact 4:3 aspect ratio. Preserve EXACT centers, size and order of all seven navigation objects in the TOP 36% of the image: DRAFT ROOM sign at x0-18%, NICK 09 jersey x24%, SCOTT 81 jersey x35%, larger ANDREW 28 championship frame x41-60%, TYLER 91 jersey x65%, CHRIS 34 jersey x77%, silver trophy plus TROPHY ROOM plaque x86-100%. All these navigation subjects must remain fully within top36%, as a single straight-on gallery. Five jerseys with perfectly legible names/numbers: NICK 09, SCOTT 81, ANDREW 28, TYLER 91, CHRIS 34. Andrew remains orange, large and prominent under CURRENT CHAMPION; other four jerseys navy with cream numbers, rendered in the theme style. Do not move the objects or change jersey colours/numbers. Below the top36%, remove all previous lettering/furniture/portrait and leave a quiet, mostly dark matching themed texture for HTML scoreboards to overlay; no standings data, no fake scores, no words, no large foreground objects below the header. No browser chrome, no mockup frame. Theme all materials, lighting and decorative elements. No Basement Bar branding. GOLDENEYE 007 N64: cinematic 1997 spy-game mission briefing wall, gunbarrel circular metal motifs, black and olive concrete bunker, restrained red laser lines, rich gold metallic frames, CRT green phosphor dossier lights. Polygonal tuxedo spy silhouette beside the DRAFT ROOM mission terminal at far left. Trophy is secured in a high-tech vault at far right. Premium dark espionage look, golden edges, readable warm cream names. Lower quiet texture dark green-black brushed tactical metal.
